about: Third-party material bundled with Untzel: the source of the credits page of the docs site (apps/docs/content/credits.md, the credits directive of tools/docs). Human-readable: THIRD_PARTY.md.

credits.title: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset
credits.performers: The 20 professional singers of VocalSet (anonymous: f1–f9, m1–m11)
credits.citation: Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl and Bryan Pardo. VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset. In Proceedings of the 19th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR), Paris, 2018.
credits.changes: Held notes cut from the straight long tones, moved to each zone root by pitch-synchronous overlap-add (and resampling past 7 semitones), summed into ensembles for the choir, band-limited to 16 kHz, levelled, looped with a baked crossfade and encoded as Opus.

credits.title: Salamander Grand Piano V3
credits.citation: "Salamander Grand Piano V3" by Alexander Holm, licensed under CC BY 3.0, modified as described under Changes made.
credits.changes: Cut at the onset, mixed to mono, resampled to 48 kHz, levelled, peak-limited, looped (sustained notes) or faded into silence (one-shots) and encoded as Opus.
